tracks.name: Acceleration (75 m)
tracks.source: Formula Student rules: 75 m straight from a standing start.

tracks.name: Skidpad (figure of eight)
tracks.source: Formula Student rules: two 15.25 m inner-diameter circles, 3 m lane. Driven line = lane centre (radius 9.125 m). Timed laps are the second lap of each circle, averaged.

tracks.name: FS UK Sprint / Autocross (1 lap)
tracks.source: Average driven line from a logged FS UK 2025 endurance stint at Silverstone (GPS, 10 Hz, 13 laps averaged, smoothed, resampled every 0.5 m). Assumption: the sprint uses the same layout as endurance.

tracks.name: FS UK Endurance (27 laps, 22 km)
tracks.source: Average driven line from a logged FS UK 2025 endurance stint at Silverstone (GPS, 10 Hz, 13 laps averaged, smoothed, resampled every 0.5 m).

tracks.name: FSG 2018 driverless track
tracks.source: Cone map shipped with AMZ Racing's FSSIM simulator (github.com/AMZ-Racing/fssim), file FSG.yaml. The simulator was used to predict lap times at FSG 2018; the year is taken from that. MIT licence, copyright (c) 2019 Akademischer Motorsportverein Zuerich. Driven line: the least-bent line that keeps the car 0.85 m from its centre to the cones.

tracks.name: FS Italy 2018 driverless track
tracks.source: Cone map shipped with AMZ Racing's FSSIM simulator (github.com/AMZ-Racing/fssim), file FSI.yaml. Reading FSI as FS Italy 2018 is an assumption: the file itself is not labelled further. MIT licence, copyright (c) 2019 Akademischer Motorsportverein Zuerich. Driven line: the least-bent line that keeps the car 0.85 m from its centre to the cones.

tracks.name: FSG 2019 driverless track
tracks.source: Cone positions traced from competition video in the layout-merchant collection (github.com/papalotis/layout-merchant). Cone positions relative to each other are right; the overall scale was estimated by its author. MIT licence, copyright (c) 2024 Panagiotis. Driven line: the least-bent line that keeps the car 0.85 m from its centre to the cones.
